page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated KVM hypervisor. The host environment provides 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware acceleration is delivered by a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. The system is provisioned with 60 GB of system memory, yielding 7.5 GB of RAM per vCPU, alongside 472 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network throughput of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate sharp contrast between CPU throughput and GPU-assisted execution. The legacy Intel Broadwell architecture produces lower CPU metric scores, with stress-ng single-core registering 954.2 and multi-core reaching 4765.11, both trailing modern compute platforms. Similarly, general compression and database operations fall in the lower quartiles. However, the bundled NVIDIA P100 provides strong acceleration for targeted machine learning tasks. In language model inference, the instance achieves 9872.83 tokens per second on prompt processing for 135M models and 316.69 tokens per second for 7B models, accompanied by 42.77 tokens per second during 7B text generation.

The primary tradeoff of this instance rests on its older CPU generation and moderate network interface against its high memory density and dedicated GPU. Cost efficiency is driven primarily by utilizing the Pascal accelerator for moderate GPU-bound workloads without incurring the expense of modern enterprise accelerator architectures. The instance is suited for deep learning inference on small to medium models, legacy GPU-accelerated scientific computations, and graphics processing pipelines that do not depend on newer tensor core architectures.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine configured with an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor delivering 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores at 2.5 GHz. The hardware profile integrates 60 GB of RAM, a 472 GB local SSD, and an NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM, operating over a 3 Gbps network baseline. While synthetic benchmarks show modest general CPU and memory throughput compared to modern x86 architectures, the onboard P100 GPU provides solid throughput for parallel workloads. The system achieves 316.69 prompt tokens per second and 42.77 generation tokens per second on 7B parameter language models. Given the resource balance, this instance is suited for small-to-medium deep learning inference, image processing, and GPU-driven legacy scientific calculations requiring dedicated VRAM.
